-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies the 1Password Service Account token and connectivity by listing vaults.

list-vaults.name: list-vaults
list-vaults.description: List the 1Password vaults accessible to the connected Service Account. Returns vault id, title, description, type and active item count. Use this first to find the vault id for list-items.

list-items.name: list-items
list-items.description: List the items in a 1Password vault. Returns item id, title, category, tags and state (no field values). Use list-vaults to get the vault id, then this tool to find the item id for get-item-fields.

params.vaultId: The ID of the vault to list items from (get it from list-vaults).
params.includeArchived: Include archived items in the listing (default: false).

get-item-fields.name: get-item-fields
get-item-fields.description: Get the fields of a 1Password item, including the values of secret fields (passwords, API keys, credentials). Use list-items to find the item id. SECURITY: treat returned secret values as sensitive — use them for the requested action (e.g. writing a secrets file) and do not echo, log or persist them anywhere else.

params.vaultId: The ID of the vault containing the item.
params.itemId: The ID of the item to read (get it from list-items).

name: 1Password
description: Read-only access to 1Password vaults, items and secret field values via a Service Account token — lets agents locate and read API keys and other secrets on demand

changelog.notes: Initial release — read-only 1Password access via Service Account: list vaults, list items per vault, and read item fields including secret values
